name: Mount Nukai
text: Mountain in Uda and Nara, Nara prefecture, Japan.

depictions.name: Mount Nukai
depictions.text: Mount Nukai is a mountain located in eastern Yamato, Japan. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke visited the mountain and retrieved a katana Iga's Flame from a hidden chest. At some point, they climbed atop a tree and oversaw Yamato.
